title: Bounded agent task from a GitHub issue
description: One issue is triaged, planned, implemented as a single whitelisted Markdown artefact, tested, reviewed and turned into a pull request. The implementation is a scripted reference pipeline; no language model is involved.
human_gate: branch protection on main requires a pull request and one approving review; the pipeline never merges
known_limitations: PRs created with GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger further workflows
